probe_gatt.name: Probe GATT (development only)
probe_gatt.description: Development-only. With FORA 6 CONNECT visibly current in Advertisement Monitor, connect through Home Assistant Bluetooth and list GATT metadata without characteristic I/O.

address.name: Bluetooth address (private)
address.description: Development-only. Copy the Bluetooth address for FORA 6 CONNECT from Settings → Connectivity → Bluetooth → Advertisement Monitor. It is used only in memory for this probe and is not returned or persisted. Do not share it publicly.

observe_notifications.name: Observe notifications (development only)
observe_notifications.description: Stage 1C only. Subscribe to three known Notify characteristics for 30 seconds and return counts and lengths without raw payloads. Bleak may configure CCCDs; no application characteristic read or write is sent.

address.name: Bluetooth address (private)
address.description: Copy the known FORA 6 CONNECT address privately from Advertisement Monitor. Used only in memory; never returned, logged, or persisted. Do not share it publicly.

probe_protocol_identity.name: Probe protocol identity (development only)
probe_protocol_identity.description: Stage 2E only. Subscribe to custom 1524, send the captured wake and project queries once each with write response, validate project 0x4183, then unsubscribe and disconnect. No records are requested.

address.name: Bluetooth address (private)
address.description: Copy the known FORA 6 CONNECT address privately from Advertisement Monitor. Used only in memory; never returned, logged, or persisted. Do not share it publicly.

probe_protocol_record.name: Probe first stored record (development only)
probe_protocol_record.description: Physical Stage 2F testing is paused pending review of corrected selector evidence. Stage 2F only: confirm GD82 identity, then query User1 record slots and raw index zero through custom 1524. Returns status only. No clock setting, pairing, or production sync.

address.name: Bluetooth address (private)
address.description: Copy the known FORA 6 CONNECT address privately from Advertisement Monitor. Used only in memory; never returned, logged, or persisted. Do not share it publicly.

probe_history_window.name: Probe bounded history window (development only)
probe_history_window.description: Stage 7B only. Confirm GD82 identity, read User1 metadata once, and request only raw indexes 1, 0, 1 when the raw slot count is exactly two. Returns structural and repeat-equality flags, never health data or private identifiers. No production synchronization.

address.name: Bluetooth address (private)
address.description: Copy the runtime meter address privately from Advertisement Monitor. Used only in memory for this manual action; never returned, logged, or persisted.

probe_history_semantics.name: Probe bounded history semantics (development only)
probe_history_semantics.description: Stage 7C only. Confirm GD82 identity, require exactly two User1 raw slots, and classify only raw indexes 1, 0, 1. Returns classification and status booleans without health values, timestamps, or private identifiers. No production synchronization.

address.name: Bluetooth address (private)
address.description: Copy the runtime meter address privately from Advertisement Monitor. Used only in memory for this manual action; never returned, logged, or persisted.

probe_history_window_four.name: Probe four-slot history window (development only)
probe_history_window_four.description: Stage 7E only. After exact count-four gate, read only User1 indexes 3, 0, 1, 2, 3. Returns structural and equality flags, never private measurements or identifiers. No production synchronization.

address.name: Bluetooth address (private)
address.description: Copy the runtime meter address privately from Advertisement Monitor. Used only in memory for this manual action; never returned or logged.

probe_history_chronology.name: Inspect two primary records (private development action)
probe_history_chronology.description: Stage 7G only. At exactly four User1 raw slots, read only indexes 0 and 2. Validated General uric-acid primaries return private mg/dL values and timezone-unknown meter-local times alongside semantic and relative-order results. Do not share this health-data response publicly. No identifiers, persistence, entity update, or production synchronization.

address.name: Bluetooth address (private)
address.description: Copy the runtime meter address privately from Advertisement Monitor. Used only in memory for this manual action; never returned or logged.

confirm.title: Confirm FORA 6 Connect
confirm.description: Connect once to confirm the GD82 model and its private device identity?

update_locator.title: Update FORA 6 Connect connection
update_locator.description: The confirmed meter is already configured at another Bluetooth locator. Update its connection locator after checking that the old locator is no longer connectable?
